Commercial Kitchen Equipment FAQs

Short answers for Bangalore buyers comparing equipment manufacturers and suppliers.

What should I check before buying commercial kitchen equipment?

Check material grade, size, sheet thickness, finishing, heat load, refrigeration needs, exhaust size, warranty and local service support.

Is SS 304 good for restaurant kitchen equipment?

Yes. SS 304 is preferred for preparation tables, sinks, counters and many custom fabrication items because it is hygienic and corrosion resistant.

Do you support custom sizes for Bangalore kitchens?

Yes. Custom sizes can be planned for work tables, sink units, storage racks, counters, exhaust hoods and other stainless steel equipment.
